cases.evidence_note: Stage 16, predicted by hand from the archived i1040gi (Schedule 1, Schedule 2, the Tax Table and Tax Computation Worksheet), p504, f8889, i8889, p4681, f8959 and i8960, by two independent agents that did not see the encoding and agreed on every shared value; recorded after comparison. Facts: Single. Wages $40,000. Taxable interest $300 from a bank, with an early withdrawal penalty of $75 (Form 1099-INT box 2). Working (predictor A): 1040 line 1z 40,000; line 2b 300; line 9 = 40,300. Sch 1 line 18 penalty on early withdrawal of savings = 1099-INT box 2 = 75 (i1040gi Sch 1 line 18); Sch 1 line 26 = 75 -> 1040 line 10. Line 11(a) = 40,300 - 75 = 40,225. Std deduction single 15,750 (f1040 margin). Line 15 = 24,475. Tax Table row 24,450-24,500 single = 2,699. No Sch 2 -> line 17 0, line 18 = 2,699; line 23 = 0.
